metadata.title: Secure-Device OT SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing operational technology devices under IEC 62443-aligned safety and security requirements.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits all Secure-Device Platform trust semantics and applies IEC 62443 safety constraints for operational technology environments.

system-characteristics.system-description: Operational Technology (OT) devices include systems that monitor or control physical processes where failure or misuse may cause physical harm, environmental damage, or infrastructure disruption. This SSPP enforces safety-first constraints over device execution, command, change, access, and lifecycle behaviors.

props.name: device-class
props.remarks: Applies to OT and cyber-physical control systems.

props.name: safety-priority
props.remarks: Physical and process safety supersede availability, automation, and performance.

props.name: authoritative-standard
props.remarks: IEC 62443 is the authoritative control framework for OT security and safety.

props.name: supporting-guidance
props.remarks: Provides interpretive guidance aligning IEC 62443 with NIST frameworks.

props.name: implicit-authorization
props.remarks: OT device execution, connectivity, or command validity must not imply authorization or safety approval.

props.name: fail-safe-expectation
props.remarks: OT devices must transition to a defined safe state during cyber, fault, or control-loss events.

system-implementation.remarks: OT devices operate under strict safety constraints enforced through IEC 62443-aligned controls. This SSPP does not prescribe tooling or vendor solutions.

roles.title: OT Security Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines OT-specific trust, zoning, and safety constraints.

roles.title: OT Security Governance
roles.remarks: Approves safety constraints, change tolerances, and risk acceptance for OT systems.

roles.title: OT Operations
roles.remarks: Operates OT systems under safety-first execution and change constraints.

roles.title: OT Safety and Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors integrity, misuse, unsafe transitions, and safety-relevant device conditions.

control-implementation.remarks: Controls are satisfied through IEC 62443-aligned implementations and constrained interpretation of Secure-Device trust signals. This SSPP does not redefine control implementations.
